name: io.github.devon-clarkk/engraphy
title: Engraphy
description: Self-hosted MCP memory server: a typed knowledge graph on Postgres 16 and pgvector.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>, where the token is issued by `engraphy-admin token create` against the space the client is entitled to. Every request to /mcp/ carries it; an unauthenticated call is refused with HTTP 401.

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAPHY_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: libpq connection string for a Postgres 16 database with the pgvector extension, reached as the non-superuser `engraphy_app` role. Required: the server refuses to start without it, and refuses to start if the schema is behind (run `engraphy-admin migrate` first).

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAPHY_BIND_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Interface the server binds. Containers reach their own loopback only, so a published container sets 0.0.0.0 and puts the boundary at the port publication and the reverse proxy.

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAPHY_BIND_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the server binds inside the container, matching the port in the transport URL.

tech.engraphy.requires: Postgres 16 with pgvector, and a bearer token issued by engraphy-admin
